SWEEP 3 POPULATION CLOSED: 38 of 38. Re-measured after a0cf33d and 392619e -- zero uncovered.

Landed this session:
  a0cf33d  StructuralChannelUnforgeableSuite -- the four private[align] structural types
           (alignJVM 228 passed, was 224; fmt 0)
  392619e  BlockedSidecarLayout added to codecprobe/ConstructionProbeSuite
           (codecJVM 110 passed; suite testOnly reports Total 10 against 8 on HEAD; fmt 0)

WHAT THE SWEEP ACTUALLY FOUND, which is worse than "37 types lacked a court". Every one of the five I probed today is FORGEABLE RIGHT NOW:

  StructuralMemberEstimate    mirror=true  fromProduct=true  copy=false  apply=false
  StructuralMemberExclusion   mirror=true  fromProduct=true  copy=false  apply=false
  StructuralReduction         mirror=true  fromProduct=true  copy=false  apply=false
  StructuralReductionReceipt  mirror=true  fromProduct=true  copy=false  apply=false
  BlockedSidecarLayout        mirror=true  fromProduct=true  copy=false  apply=false

`private` and `private[align]` behave IDENTICALLY: both close the two doors people look at and leave the Mirror door open from any package. I flagged the fully-private case as possibly different and measured it rather than assuming; it is not different.

Two of the five are evidence types whose forgeability is the whole problem: StructuralReductionReceipt is an audit receipt that can attest a reduction that never ran, and BlockedSidecarLayout is the evidence that byte arithmetic was checked, every field an offset or a length, handed to a reader about to index into a file.

FIX BEAD: bd-01M19JBF0X827AS3J863TX1J8E, P1, open, unassigned. Both new suites PIN THE KNOWN-BAD STATE and go red when it is repaired, by design.

CAVEAT ON THE COVERAGE NUMBER, restated because closing this bead should not launder it. "38 of 38 covered" means every type is NAMED BY A SUITE THAT USES typeChecks/typeCheckErrors. It does NOT mean every court has teeth. My earlier note said the count over-counts and that remains true for the 33 I did not write today. bd-01M1836WDBB72KXXPKG23PSSWT (probe coverage: 12 of 21 construction-boundary suites tested...) is the bead for that weakness and I have just reset it to open. A LATER READER SHOULD NOT TAKE THIS CLOSURE AS "THE CONSTRUCTION BOUNDARIES ARE PROVEN" -- it means the population is enumerated and every member has a court, which is a prerequisite for that claim and not the claim.

Both gates are LocallyObserved, not Confirmed: I authored and ran them. SHAs are in the commits for anyone converting them.
